posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
Featureless blocks and cylinders don't get my juices flowing.  However, a meeple-tastic add-on/upgrade for the Kickstarter like meeplesource.com has for Dominant Species would be fantastic (with aliens rather than monkeys, butterflies, spiders, snakes, etc. of course):

![](upload://zBjrnW9sSxLekOyB59EjeZpUGvh.jpeg)

The Pandemic germ set would be great for life before it's evolved:

![](upload://b8XrPg3PIoXSOV99pfeOxQGRoBO.jpeg)

Each evolved species could be different from each other:

![](upload://9mg2kopO6cai0GxGPCU3RlwsQsf.jpeg)![](upload://3ohpqHkXG1Oe3rvWzZpcDRHRQA3.jpeg)![](upload://5OX2m3Ri6RCf4mdVtOIpwWVvUuq.jpeg)![](upload://kVXKRHINdOJJlAbxswzlTk4kwqk.jpeg)![](upload://lzoGQ0ZULnrHAaTgaqs9dCOcHVO.jpeg)

I'm just saying, there are a world of meeple-tastic opportunities out there.
